summary: The candidate adds sound regression coverage for the exact reported DeepSeek-V4 SWA geometry and confirms that the already-present base implementation makes progress by chunking. It is test-only hardening, not a production fix. Its broad claim that intrinsically oversized requests no longer starve is incomplete: when the drained SWA pool cannot hold even the reserved page/decode headroom, _swa_chunk_cap is zero and add_one_req silently returns NO_TOKEN forever.

tests.what_was_measured: Exact candidate regression at commit 1d3dec7: 7 focused tests passed, including the reported 20,992/32,768/512/20,742 geometry.
Exact candidate PrefillAdder module: 30 tests and 12 subtests passed.

Independent adversarial review: simulated historical gate repeatedly blocked the reported head while a short tail was runnable; current source progressed for 20,742 through 65,536-token prompts; a drained 512-token pool with 512-token pages produced zero chunk capacity and three permanent NO_TOKEN deferrals.

gpu_execution_evidence: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 exposed one AMD Instinct MI350X with gfx950, but the reviewed scheduler admission path is CPU-only and launched no GPU kernel.
remaining_counterexamples: With size_swa=rem_swa=512, page_size=512, max_new_tokens=1, and a 2,000-token prompt, _swa_req_never_fits is true but _swa_chunk_cap is zero; add_one_req returns NO_TOKEN indefinitely with no terminal rejection.
Any intrinsically oversized request for which reserved page/decode/load-back headroom leaves less than one page-aligned extend chunk follows the same permanent-deferral branch.
remaining_limitations: The prepared base already includes the production escape hatch, so failing-before was reproduced by disabling that decision in-process rather than by running an actual historical buggy checkout.
DeepSeek-V4-Pro/DSpark weights and the reported 1P1D TP4+TP4, mooncake, multi-node, 8xB300 deployment were unavailable; no full serving-path or model-semantic verification is claimed.
The deterministic fixture validates scheduler admission arithmetic and FCFS-head progress only.
No native source changed in the candidate, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
